sources.title: The entropy of bulk quantum fields and the entanglement wedge of an evaporating black hole

evidence.text: Can bulk quantum entropy significantly displace quantum extremal surfaces during black-hole evaporation, and can the resulting entanglement wedge reproduce the Page curve and Hayden-Preskill information-recovery delay?

sources.title: The Page curve of Hawking radiation from semiclassical geometry

evidence.text: Can semiclassical geometry directly produce the Page curve of Hawking radiation, without merely inferring it from purity of the combined black hole–radiation state, and what entropy prescription accounts for interior islands?

sources.title: Replica Wormholes and the Entropy of Hawking Radiation

evidence.text: Can the gravitational replica path integral directly yield a radiation entropy compatible with unitarity and the island rule, without higher-dimensional holographic input?

sources.title: The entropy of Hawking radiation

evidence.text: How can gravitational fine-grained entropy methods compute Hawking-radiation entropy consistently with unitary evaporation, despite the growing entropy obtained from the semiclassical radiation state?

sources.title: Hints of gravitational ergodicity: Berry’s ensemble and the universality of the semi-classical Page curve

evidence.text: Can an ensemble-averaged semiclassical calculation recover a unitarity-compatible Page curve within a single unitary theory, with the ensemble representing epoch time averages rather than distinct microscopic theories?

sources.title: Page curve and symmetries

evidence.text: How do conserved charges and explicit charge violation modify Page curves and symmetry-resolved entropies in a random qubit evaporation model, and what conditional lessons might this provide about black-hole evaporation and symmetries?

sources.title: Information in black hole radiation

evidence.text: Can perturbative calculations exclude gradual information recovery in black-hole radiation if unitary evaporation encodes information in exponentially small corrections or widely distributed correlations?

sources.title: The entropy of bulk quantum fields and the entanglement wedge of an evaporating black hole

evidence.text: Conformal and Weyl transformations map the matter state to a half-plane vacuum. Replica twist-operator correlators and a formal n→1 limit give interval entropies; conformal anomalies determine stress-tensor expectation values.

sources.title: The Page curve of Hawking radiation from semiclassical geometry

evidence.text: Solve Schwarzian equations for coordinates w± that locally remove the chiral stress tensor after a Weyl transformation. Match the induced metric to determine the Planck-brane embedding. The deeper three-dimensional geometry still encodes state information and can affect extremal-surface areas.

sources.title: Replica Wormholes and the Entropy of Hawking Radiation

evidence.text: Use conformal welding: interior and exterior holomorphic maps obey G(e^{iθ(τ)}) = F(e^{iτ}). Their nonlocal dependence on the boundary reparametrization enters a modified Schwarzian equation relating boundary energy change to matter energy flux.

sources.title: The entropy of Hawking radiation

evidence.text: Quantum extremal surface prescription: S = min_X ext_X[Area(X)/(4G_N) + S_semi-cl(Σ_X)], with X codimension two and Σ_X bounded by X and the cutoff. Extremize in spacetime, then select the smallest extremal value. The review also describes a maximin construction over Cauchy slices.

sources.title: Hints of gravitational ergodicity: Berry’s ensemble and the universality of the semi-classical Page curve

evidence.text: Organize higher moments diagrammatically through noncrossing partitions and their multiplicities. Crossing diagrams are claimed subleading when both box overlap traces are much smaller than one; continue the resulting Rényi expression toward n=1.

sources.title: Page curve and symmetries

evidence.text: Average products of random phases to calculate charge-sector and total purities, then express second Rényi curves through those averaged purities. Sector dimensions in the qubit example are binomial coefficients.

sources.title: Soft black hole information paradox: Page curve from Maxwell soft hair of a black hole

evidence.text: Can Maxwell soft hair be described quantitatively as boundary edge modes, and can measurements of those modes compete with Hawking entanglement production to produce a Page-like curve for black-hole entropy?

sources.title: Wet Hair: Global Symmetries in Entanglement Islands

evidence.text: Can continuous global symmetries consistently act on particles in entanglement islands, and do such examples support a connection between unitarity and the absence of global symmetries in quantum gravity?

sources.title: Black hole entropy as entanglement entropy: A Holographic derivation

evidence.text: Can black hole entropy be identified entirely with quantum-field entanglement across the horizon while accounting for ultraviolet dependence, the species problem, and gravitational backreaction?

sources.title: Charge fluctuation entropy of Hawking radiation: A replica-free way to find large entropy

evidence.text: Can charge probabilities supply a replica-free lower bound on Hawking-radiation entropy that conflicts with entropy saturation? How do global symmetry, gauging, and replica-wormhole holonomies affect that conflict and constrain two-dimensional couplings?

sources.title: Asymptotic Algebras and Holography of Information in CGHS Model

evidence.text: Does a specified gravitational completion of CGHS radiation encode its global state near past null-boundary endpoints, and can right-radiation island reconstruction coexist with exact left/right radiative commutativity?

sources.title: Global symmetry, Euclidean gravity, and the black hole information problem

evidence.text: Can assumptions behind a unitary black-hole Page curve exclude global symmetries beyond AdS/CFT, and what connects the success of Euclidean gravitational entropy calculations to holographic UV completion?

sources.title: A violation of global symmetries from replica wormholes and the fate of black hole remnants

evidence.text: Do replica wormholes violate global-charge conservation even when the effective Lagrangian preserves the symmetry, and does the resulting nonorthogonality of charged states remove the excessive-degeneracy objection to black-hole remnants?

sources.title: Islands far outside the horizon

evidence.text: Can islands associated with high-angular-momentum Hawking modes extend parametrically beyond the stretched horizon, and can asymptotic observers probe the resulting conflict with semiclassical locality?

sources.title: Islands in cosmology

evidence.text: When can quantum extremal islands exist in general spacetimes, and can crunching cosmological regions be encoded in auxiliary systems or non-crunching regions?

sources.title: Replica wormholes and the black hole interior

evidence.text: Can gravitational replica wormholes justify the island prescription and Page curve, directly explain reconstruction of black-hole interior operators from radiation, and clarify the ensemble averaging implicit in these calculations?

sources.title: Global symmetry violation from nonisometric codes

evidence.text: Can a non-isometric encoding of charged black-hole interior states produce global-symmetry violation in radiation while reproducing a quantum-extremal-surface entropy formula, and how can relative entropies quantify that violation?

sources.title: Unitarity and Page Curve for Evaporation of 2D AdS Black Holes

evidence.text: Can semiclassical JT black-hole evaporation with backreaction, supplemented by an effective dual-CFT description of entanglement, yield a regular endpoint and a radiation Page curve consistent with unitarity?

sources.title: Jerusalem Lectures on Black Holes and Quantum Information

evidence.text: How can black-hole evaporation preserve quantum information while allowing a smooth experience for an infalling observer, and how do quantum information theory and holography sharpen this problem?

sources.title: Entanglement Wedge Reconstruction and the Information Paradox

evidence.text: Can quantum extremal surfaces and entanglement wedge reconstruction explain the Page curve, information recovery and a smooth evaporating horizon while retaining semiclassical Hawking entanglement? How does recovery depend on knowledge of the initial state?

sources.title: Black Hole's 1/N Hair

evidence.text: Within the proposed graviton-condensate description, do finite-occupation quantum effects produce detectable black-hole hair for nongauged conserved charges, and do they invalidate the usual black-hole argument against continuous global symmetries?

sources.title: Skyrmion Black Hole Hair: Conservation of Baryon Number by Black Holes and Observable Manifestations

evidence.text: Does classical skyrmion hair undermine semiclassical evaporation arguments against baryon-number conservation, and how would such hair affect scalar-wave scattering?

sources.title: A Chern-Simons Pandemic

evidence.text: Which mechanisms prevent continuous generalized global symmetries from producing black-hole remnant problems, especially when infrared effects suppress the charged configurations that would ordinarily break the symmetry?

sources.title: Kac-Moody instantons in space-time foam as an alternative solution to the black hole information paradox

evidence.text: Can self-dual Yang–Mills and gravitational instantons on space-time foam furnish Kac–Moody quantum hairs that encode black hole information?

sources.title: Approximate Symmetries and Gravity

evidence.text: How exact can emergent global symmetries be in gravitational EFTs, and can thermal black-hole charge loss quantitatively bound local symmetry violation?

sources.title: Infinite Black Hole Entropies at Infinite Distances and Tower of States

evidence.text: Can a black hole with exponentially many nearly degenerate microstates develop a parametrically light set of excitations as entropy grows? The appendix studies this question using N-portrait assumptions and a simplified finite-factor model.

sources.title: Global symmetry, Euclidean gravity, and the black hole information problem

evidence.text: Can assumptions behind a unitary black-hole Page curve exclude global symmetries beyond AdS/CFT, and what connects the success of Euclidean gravitational entropy calculations to holographic UV completion?

sources.title: Signatures of global symmetry violation in relative entropies and replica wormholes

evidence.text: Can global symmetry violation be quantified using only part of the Hawking radiation, before the endpoint of evaporation, despite symmetry-violating correlators being nonperturbatively small?

sources.title: A universal formula for the density of states in theories with finite-group symmetry

evidence.text: At fixed energy, how are black hole microstates distributed among irreducible representations of a finite long-range gauge group G? Can the resulting distribution also describe sufficiently high-energy states in QFTs with finite global symmetry?

sources.title: Wet Hair: Global Symmetries in Entanglement Islands

evidence.text: Can continuous global symmetries consistently act on particles in entanglement islands, and do such examples support a connection between unitarity and the absence of global symmetries in quantum gravity?

sources.title: Discrete gauge symmetry in continuum theories

evidence.text: Can discrete symmetries in continuum low-energy theories have a local gauge origin, and can that origin enforce conservation and produce observable black-hole hair despite the absence of a low-energy gauge potential?

sources.title: Black Hole's 1/N Hair

evidence.text: Extend the tagged-particle counting to B equally charged constituents, formulate coupled occupation-number and charge-depletion laws, and examine their small-B/N evolution. Compare these finite-N effects with a double-scaling semiclassical limit; the extracted integrated solution is not reconstructed in this pass.

sources.title: Skyrmion Black Hole Hair: Conservation of Baryon Number by Black Holes and Observable Manifestations

evidence.text: Regular skyrmions are obtained through hedgehog energy minimization with F(0)=Bπ and F(∞)=0. Gravitating configurations use coupled Einstein–Skyrme boundary-value equations for the profile, mass function and lapse, with asymptotic normalization.

sources.title: A Chern-Simons Pandemic

evidence.text: Impose a periodic-scalar winding condition, reduce its kinetic term with the KK connection, and identify the induced covariant derivative. Treat changing the winding sector separately from varying continuous fields within one sector.

sources.title: Kac-Moody instantons in space-time foam as an alternative solution to the black hole information paradox

evidence.text: Employ quantum-group representations, a regularized Verlinde formula, and analytic continuation to self-dual variables for state counting; use infinitesimal Wilson loops to regularize the singular boundary contribution.

sources.title: Approximate Symmetries and Gravity

evidence.text: Semiclassical two-body collision estimates, radiation-fluctuation entropy and nonrelativistic Poisson statistics feed Boltzmann estimates of black-hole formation and equilibration.

sources.title: Infinite Black Hole Entropies at Infinite Distances and Tower of States

evidence.text: Deform the Schwarzschild angular factor, compare regulated curvatures at matched dimensionless points, take their ratio, and remove the common regulator. The procedure recovers logarithmic radius dependence but retains point-matching and regulator assumptions.

sources.title: Soft black hole information paradox: Page curve from Maxwell soft hair of a black hole

evidence.text: Can Maxwell soft hair be described quantitatively as boundary edge modes, and can measurements of those modes compete with Hawking entanglement production to produce a Page-like curve for black-hole entropy?

sources.title: The Scattering matrix approach for the quantum black hole: An Overview

evidence.text: Can black-hole formation and evaporation admit a unitary scattering matrix with finite entropy and a discrete spectrum, and what horizon degrees of freedom would implement it?

sources.title: Charge fluctuation entropy of Hawking radiation: A replica-free way to find large entropy

evidence.text: Can charge probabilities supply a replica-free lower bound on Hawking-radiation entropy that conflicts with entropy saturation? How do global symmetry, gauging, and replica-wormhole holonomies affect that conflict and constrain two-dimensional couplings?

sources.title: Statistical hair on black holes

evidence.text: Can an extremal black hole's quantum microstate be measured in the regime with an event horizon, despite the apparent semiclassical no-hair obstruction?

sources.title: A violation of global symmetries from replica wormholes and the fate of black hole remnants

evidence.text: Do replica wormholes violate global-charge conservation even when the effective Lagrangian preserves the symmetry, and does the resulting nonorthogonality of charged states remove the excessive-degeneracy objection to black-hole remnants?

sources.title: Page curve and symmetries

evidence.text: How do conserved charges and explicit charge violation modify Page curves and symmetry-resolved entropies in a random qubit evaporation model, and what conditional lessons might this provide about black-hole evaporation and symmetries?

sources.title: Unrecognizable black holes in two-dimensions

evidence.text: Does the CGHS model's nonlinear global symmetry survive quantization together with BRST symmetry, and does its survival prevent the model's Weyl-invariant matter from recognizing a black-hole background or producing radiation?

sources.title: Global symmetry violation from nonisometric codes

evidence.text: Can a non-isometric encoding of charged black-hole interior states produce global-symmetry violation in radiation while reproducing a quantum-extremal-surface entropy formula, and how can relative entropies quantify that violation?

evidence.text: Does the CGHS model's nonlinear global symmetry survive quantization together with BRST symmetry, and does its survival prevent the model's Weyl-invariant matter from recognizing a black-hole background or producing radiation?

sources.title: Hawking radiation as tunneling

evidence.text: Can Hawking emission be derived directly as horizon tunneling while enforcing energy conservation, and how does the resulting emission law depart from thermality?

sources.title: Distinguishing Schwinger effect from Hawking radiation in Reissner-Nordström black holes via entanglement

evidence.text: The island prescription minimizes an extremized generalized entropy. For nearby entangling boundaries, the finite matter entropy is approximated by −κ4 c Area(∂R)/L², with L evaluated using near-horizon Kruskal coordinates.

sources.title: Unrecognizable black holes in two-dimensions

evidence.text: Remove BRST-doublet auxiliary sectors and antighost dependence from candidate nontrivial cocycles. Classify local polynomial densities by ghost number, canonical dimension and covariant building blocks Y±, C±, F±i and G±, using covariant spatial derivatives and a discrete interchange symmetry.

sources.title: Hawking radiation as tunneling

evidence.text: Calculate the alternative negative-energy inward-tunneling channel by reversing time and using the antiparticle contour prescription. For the conductor comparison, use image charges to include the emitted charge's back-reaction.

sources.title: Distinguishing Schwinger effect from Hawking radiation in Reissner-Nordström black holes via entanglement

evidence.text: A conical replica construction computes scalar entropy from the one-loop heat kernel of D=−(∇−iqA)²+m². The small-proper-time coefficients determine UV terms; renormalization combines these with the bare Einstein–Hilbert and quadratic-curvature couplings.

sources.title: Distinguishing Schwinger effect from Hawking radiation in Reissner-Nordström black holes via entanglement

evidence.text: An alternative WKB brick-wall calculation counts scalar modes and derives thermal free energy. Pauli–Villars regularization adds five regulator fields satisfying ΣΔi=0 and ΣΔimi²=0. The wall position is calibrated to match the heat-kernel result.

sources.title: Unrecognizable black holes in two-dimensions

evidence.text: Use an ADM Hamiltonian parametrization and BFV extended phase space. Four first-class constraints include two Virasoro-generating secondary constraints. Construct the BRST charge before gauge fixing; the vanishing canonical Hamiltonian gives HT={Q,Ψ}PB.

sources.title: Les Houches lectures on black holes

evidence.text: How can black-hole formation and evaporation be reconciled with quantum superposition, energy conservation and unitarity? The lectures use two-dimensional models to examine semiclassical evaporation and constrain possible descriptions beyond its endpoint.

sources.title: A stringy effect on Hawking radiation

evidence.text: Can exponential suppression of trans-Planckian interactions in a string-inspired nonlocal field theory change Hawking radiation, particularly after the scrambling time?

sources.title: UV Effects and Short-Lived Hawking Radiation: Alternative Resolution of Information Paradox

evidence.text: Can trans-Planckian effects suppress the magnitude of Hawking radiation near the scrambling time, leaving a macroscopic black hole that retains information and avoids the usual evaporation paradox?

sources.title: Black Hole as a Quantum Field Configuration

evidence.text: Can semiclassical gravity and quantum matter provide a self-consistent evaporating black-hole interior, explain its supporting pressure and energy loss, and reproduce the entropy area law by counting field configurations?

sources.title: Particle creation by black holes

evidence.text: Does quantum matter on a classical collapse spacetime produce persistent black-hole emission, and what does that imply for temperature, horizon-area decrease, thermodynamics and evaporation?

sources.title: Unitarity and Page Curve for Evaporation of 2D AdS Black Holes

evidence.text: Can semiclassical JT black-hole evaporation with backreaction, supplemented by an effective dual-CFT description of entanglement, yield a regular endpoint and a radiation Page curve consistent with unitarity?
